name: Zetsumetsu King -Seikimatsu Inran Kyousoukyoku-
original_name: 絶滅キング-世紀末淫乱狂想曲-
source:
Main character calls himself the Extinct King. (Zetsumetsu King) Who has the power to destroy all life on Earth. He sets an aim to have sex with seven women in the span of a month. But alas, he does not have the power to control the will of the girls, so he starts with nanpa. 

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/12/vn-of-month-march-2000.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公自称“灭绝之王”（Zetsumetsu King），拥有毁灭地球上一切生命的力量。他的目标是在一个月内与七名女性发生关系。但遗憾的是，他没有控制女孩意志的能力，所以从搭讪开始。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/12/vn-of-month-march-2000.html]vndbreview[/url]]
